'''''Runeer''''' was the designation of a group of two [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]] under the service of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were used by the Alliance as part of their first attack on Space Installation [[NL-1]]. But were destroyed by the stations defenses, which included Imperial Ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
These corvettes will appear only on the hardest difficulty setting of Battle 3 Mission 4.
